transforms.search: async function syncGoogleDrive(){if(!state.accessToken){await signInGoogle();if(!state.accessToken)return}try{const headers={Authorization:`Bearer ${state.accessToken}`},query=encodeURIComponent("name='BriefCraft AI.workspace.json' and trashed=false"),found=await fetch(`https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files?q=${query}&fields=files(id,name)&spaces=drive`,{headers}).then(r=>r.json()),payload=JSON.stringify({format:"briefcraft-workspace-v2",projects:state.projects,activeProject:state.activeProject,theme:state.theme,language:state.language});let id=found.files?.[0]?.id;if(!id){const created=await fetch("https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files",{method:"POST",headers:{...headers,"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify({name:"BriefCraft AI.workspace.json",mimeType:"application/json"})}).then(r=>r.json());id=created.id}const response=await fetch(`https://www.googleapis.com/upload/drive/v3/files/${id}?uploadType=media`,{method:"PATCH",headers:{...headers,"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:payload});if(!response.ok)throw new Error("Upload failed");showToast(tr("syncReady"));logChange(tr("syncReady"))}catch{showToast(tr("syncFailed"))}}
